name: stress-ng veccmp
description: Start N workers that perform various unsigned integer math comparison operations on various 128 bit vectors. A mix of integer vector comparison operations are performed on the following vectors: 16 x 8 bits, 8 x 16 bits, 4 x 32 bits, 2 x 64 bits and if supported 1 x 128 bits. The metrics produced by this mix depend on the processor architecture and the vector math optimisations produced by the compiler. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
